data.one_liner: A Dart library to decode and encode NFC Data Exchange Format (NDEF) records.
data.what_it_does: Decodes and encodes various types of NDEF records such as NFC Well-known, Media, Absolute URI, and External records. Provides support for data-binding by implementing payloads as dynamic getters and setters.
use_when: You need to handle NFC Data Exchange Format (NDEF) records in a Dart or Flutter application.
You are parsing or building NFC messages like text, URIs, smart posters, or Bluetooth pairing data.
avoid_when: You are looking for higher-level NFC platform bindings for reading/writing tags (this package only handles NDEF encoding/decoding).
strengths: Supports multiple NDEF record types (TNF 1 through TNF 4).
Provides extension methods for seamless encoding and decoding.
weaknesses: Under active development and subject to breaking API changes.
